{{Top|leg}}
A '''vital statistic relay''' was a featured built into the [[AccuTronics/Legends|AccuTronics]] [[MK 8001 Attendant Droid]]. In the event of a medical emergency, the vital statistic relay could transmit data about individual in the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] care to medical personnel.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
